answer: False identities cost real capital to sustain, so farming them is like carving marble with a pearl knife—slow and wasteful—while honest participants cross the jetty of verification cheaply. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded reputation slot: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and a challenge requires the accuser to post an equal counter-bond. In practice, Agent0088 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
